ranked.headline: Validation of evaluation practice for biological foundation-model predictions
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks test whether reported gains reflect degree shortcuts, sequence-similarity confounds, or uninformative attention readouts.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of population-level properties from aggregate omics data
ranked.summary: Recent work applies generative and regularized models to heterogeneous, sparse, or pooled measurements where individual-level ground truth is limited.

ranked.headline: Compression and alignment-free methods make long genomic sequence models more efficient
ranked.summary: Long-context DNA models and pangenome-scale datasets make input compression and reduced representations central to tractable genomic analysis.

ranked.headline: Models infer tumor expression and methylation biomarkers from cancer omics data
ranked.summary: Expanded cancer cohorts with matched RNA-seq, single-cell and mutation data now allow learned models to be trained and benchmarked at scale.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings fused with structural or relational inputs for…
ranked.summary: Recent papers pair pretrained protein language model embeddings with structural, graph or multi-source features for peptide, binding and paratope prediction.

ranked.headline: Quantifying tissue and cell structure from images and spatial transcriptomes
ranked.summary: Multiscale spatial and imaging readouts are now coupled with transcriptomic and multiomic frameworks to resolve tissue and cell structure.

ranked.headline: Spatial and genetic structure models applied to plant disease and immune data
ranked.summary: New spatial entropy and self-organizing map methods quantify spatial dependence and genetic structure across plant and immune datasets.

ranked.headline: Physical models link mechanical forces to epithelial and nuclear cell state transitions
ranked.summary: Mechanistic models now translate junction, nuclear envelope, and tissue forces into testable predictions for cell state and tissue organization.

ranked.headline: Engineering faster exact alignment, simulation, and k-mer placement for sequencing data
ranked.summary: Reported speedups of up to 900x for exact local alignment and 15-24x for read simulation make throughput an active engineering target.

ranked.headline: Graph and sequence neural networks predict drug-target and protein-protein binding
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply graph neural networks and cross-attention models to interaction and affinity prediction without relying on docking.

ranked.headline: Genomic and gene-level models link microbial genes and plasmids to hosts and disease
ranked.summary: Large genome and gene-level datasets are being paired with computational models to infer plasmid hosts, host sex, and functional typing in microbiomes.

ranked.headline: Learned representations are shifting biomolecular design from prediction toward generation
ranked.summary: Learned sequence and structure embeddings are now coupled to generators, reward functions, and energetic objectives across AAV, peptide, pocket, and lipid…

ranked.headline: Binding free energy, synthesizable generative design, and GPU virtual screening
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published platform extend absolute binding free energy and virtual screening to new ligand and synthesizability constraints.

ranked.headline: Simulations and sequence patterning shape peptide and viral RNA phase separation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair high-throughput simulation with sequence-level design of phase-separating peptides and disordered polypeptides.

ranked.headline: Inferring cancer genome state and structural variation from somatic sequencing data
ranked.summary: Patient-level models, two-hit analyses, and donor-specific assemblies are sharpening somatic variant interpretation and detection in cancer genomes.

ranked.headline: Computational methods infer gene regulation and integrate single-cell omics at scale
ranked.summary: Perturbation, lineage and recombination barcodes now supply causal and pooled-sample structure that new inference frameworks can model explicitly.

ranked.headline: Epigenomic and 3D genome profiling assigns regulatory roles to noncoding elements
ranked.summary: Multimodal single-cell profiling and new chromatin-state, 3D-enhancer and eccDNA tools sharpen regulatory annotation of the noncoding genome.

ranked.headline: Single-cell profiling links regulatory programs to human tissue and EMT transcriptomic…
ranked.summary: A multiomic cortex atlas and cross-tissue regulatory models now quantify how human transcriptomic states are encoded in regulatory architecture.

ranked.headline: Manual curation and multi-species pipelines expose errors in eukaryotic gene models
ranked.summary: Recent curation and multi-species annotation work targets gene-model accuracy across nematode and fly genomes.

ranked.headline: Biology foundation models face benchmarks, bias audits and synergy tests
ranked.summary: Biological foundation models are now judged on predictive gains, hidden artifacts and whether multimodal fusion adds information beyond alignment.

ranked.headline: Neural networks and contrastive learning map genotypes and omics to complex traits
ranked.summary: Interpretable and multimodal deep models are now being applied to GWAS loci, epigenetic age, brain imaging and multi-omics cancer subtypes.

ranked.headline: Software frameworks extract quantitative information from single-molecule data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair single-molecule imaging and nanopore data with inferential software for protein dynamics and peptide sensing.

ranked.headline: Graph and language-model embeddings infer RNA, protein, and drug-disease interactions
ranked.summary: Foundation-model embeddings paired with graph architectures now target zero-shot prediction of unmeasured biological interactions.

ranked.headline: Critical and attractor dynamics emerge as candidate brain connectivity markers
ranked.summary: Criticality, attractor dynamics, and EEG decoding are now quantified as candidate connectivity markers across MEG, EEG, and mouse fMRI.

ranked.headline: Simulations link membrane curvature, capsid mechanics, and nuclear pore transport
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained and atomistic simulations now probe membrane remodeling, capsid mechanics, and nuclear transport at molecular resolution.

ranked.headline: Offset-corrected RNA-seq tools and long-read transcriptome assembly benchmarks
ranked.summary: Recent studies benchmark RNA-seq tools against simulated and spike-in standards and automate GEO metadata curation to support dataset reuse.

ranked.headline: Genomics links pathogen dispersal, secretome folds and archaeal defense evolution
ranked.summary: Large genome and structure-based datasets now resolve how dispersal, fold conservation, and defense repertoires shape microbial evolution.

ranked.headline: Web and CLI tools make genotyping, phenotype and cancer biomarker data explorable
ranked.summary: Published and preprint tools now expose IMPC knockout, Axiom genotyping and TCGA biomarker analyses through browser, GUI and command-line interfaces.

ranked.headline: Protonation state and channel asymmetry govern membrane permeation in MD simulations
ranked.summary: Long-timescale and all-atom MD now resolve how protonation state and structural asymmetry shape fluoride conduction and polymyxin penetration.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models integrate single-cell and cross-species data across modalities
ranked.summary: Foundation and deep learning models now jointly handle scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, batch effects, and cross-species atlas alignment.

ranked.headline: Frameworks for in silico modeling of immune repertoires and viral sequence evolution
ranked.summary: Recent preprints formalize AIRR-seq simulator comparison and add HLA-aware immune response to within-host virus simulation.

ranked.headline: Genomic analyses move beyond a single fixed reference coordinate system
ranked.summary: Pangenome, repeat-based, and assembly-transfer methods are reducing dependence on one linear reference for variant and population analyses.

ranked.headline: Crop pangenomes link structural variants to fruit color and disease resistance
ranked.summary: Long-read and telomere-to-telomere assemblies now resolve structural variants across eggplant and tomato accessions and species for breeding.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide annotation of human endogenous retrovirus LTR regulatory features
ranked.summary: Recent work annotates human endogenous retrovirus LTRs genome-wide while new methods map RBP-RNA interactions and tRNA modification sites.

ranked.headline: Acquisition-aware and scalable software for DIA, glycopeptide, and top-down MS data
ranked.summary: Narrow-window DIA, glycopeptide, and top-down spectral resources now scale to millions of spectra in open-source tools.

ranked.headline: Computational models nominate candidate genes and liver metabolic reprogramming
ranked.summary: Tissue-resolved transcriptomic resources and multi-omics pipelines now enable computational prioritization of candidate genes and metabolic behaviors.

ranked.headline: Geometry-optimized conformer libraries and force matching extend protein sampling
ranked.summary: Energy-profiled conformational ensembles and QM/MM-derived force fields are now available at scale for assessing and extending biomolecular simulations.

ranked.headline: Parallel search tools accelerate remote homology detection in protein sequence databases
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and the published Cascade PSI-BLAST 2.0 release extend parallel and integrative workflows to large sequence databases.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of proteolytic cleavage from peptidomes and proteomic data
ranked.summary: Proteolytic cleavage is now inferred from single-snapshot proteomic and peptidomic data, without labelling or time-course sampling.

ranked.headline: Chemical reaction network models of stochastic gene expression and cell-free systems
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair reaction-timing and stochastic treatments of gene expression with quantitative fitting, experiment design, and cell-free validation.
